Any instructions will be rejected by T2S.' The must-not condition is absent; the only against-payment outcome described (external-CSD delivery 'released and debited on 2/5 together with the corresponding cash credit') is reproduced as printed and expressly distinguished from 'settlement of a EUR DvP inside ES-MIL on 1 May'. Both hidden points are present, including 'no payments in EURO may be made on May 1st; payments will be postponed', the X-TRM 'limitations due to the impossibility of settling the cash part', and the LIMITATION that notices 'are not the Service Regulations or Instructions' with Italian as authoritative language; the answer also correctly frames the evidence as an advance notice, not a record of the day.
